modules.name: Reinforced Hull
modules.description: Plated sheet welded over the cab and doors. Heavy, and it shows in the fuel ledger.

modules.name: Laminated Glass
modules.description: Shatter layers cut to the cab frame. You can still see out, which is the entire point.

modules.name: Spike Strips
modules.description: Angle iron run along the sills. Anything that grabs the vehicle hurts itself doing it.

modules.name: Underbody Plate
modules.description: A skid plate under the pan. Meant for debris, often it is mines.

modules.name: Extended Cargo Bed
modules.description: The bed runs back further than the frame was built for. It sags when it is full.

modules.name: Roof Rack
modules.description: Bolt-on rails over the cab. Cheap capacity, paid for in drag and in dust.

modules.name: Towed Trailer
modules.description: Everything the vehicle cannot carry, dragged behind it. Turning becomes a decision.

modules.name: Insulated Hold
modules.description: A lined compartment that keeps a load out of the heat. It does not run itself.

modules.name: Sleeper Bunks
modules.description: Two doubles stacked into the back. It is not a room. It is enough to sleep.

modules.name: Field Medical Bay
modules.description: A stretcher bracket, a lamp, a triage bed, and a locked case. The case is the reason for the rest.

modules.name: Field Galley
modules.description: A bolted stove and a work top. Something warm, somewhere that is not the shelter.

modules.name: Water Reservoir
modules.description: A baffled tank under the bed. The weight sits low, which helps, and slows.

modules.name: Mounted Gun
modules.description: A pintle mount over the cab. It answers a roadblock, and it invites one.

modules.name: Ram Plate
modules.description: A wedge on the front frame. Designed to end a conversation about who goes first.

modules.name: Smoke Launcher
modules.description: Tubes along the rail. Whatever the situation is, the answer is not being seen in it.

modules.name: Flare Cannon
modules.description: Short-range launcher for signal and for fire. Mostly for signal.

modules.name: Recovery Winch
modules.description: Cable, drum, and a hook. The most used module on any vehicle that leaves the road.

modules.name: Light Crane
modules.description: A folding jib for lifting what two people should not try to lift. It changes what a stop is for.

modules.name: Solar Panels
modules.description: Panels over the bed charging a separate bank. On a grey day it is a decoration.

modules.name: Field Radio Set
modules.description: A set and an antenna on the rail. Being able to call is worth more than being able to carry.
